page.overview:
Who is Sor Talgron?

Sor Talgron, later called "The Warmonger", was a member of the Word Bearers Legion who was originally a line warrior but later became a Dark Apostle of the Legion during the Horus Heresy.

He became a Dark Apostle after the XVIIth Legion turned Traitor and he had suffered near-mortal wounds from an attack using phosphex.

Talgron was a native of Colchis, the homeworld of the XVIIth Legion's Primarch Lorgar. During the Siege of Terra at the end of the Heresy, Talgron was struck down by the Loyalist defenders of the Imperial Palace. He was then interred within the cybernetic sarcophagus of a Chaos Dreadnought and became known as "The Warmonger".

The Warmonger ultimately met his fate 10,000 Terran years later in the 41st Millennium during the Battle of Boros Prime when he was responsible for the death of the Necron Lord known as The Undying One.
